text:
Three statements about energy changes in chemical reactions are listed.
1
In an endothermic reaction, the temperature of the surroundings increases.
2
In an exothermic reaction, thermal energy is taken in from the surroundings.
3
In the reaction pathway diagram for an exothermic reaction, the energy level of the
products is lower than the energy level of the reactants.
Which statements are correct?
A
1 and 2
B
1 only
C
2 and 3
D
3 only
subject: Chemistry
